item.title: Alkippos #3682 was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel
item.description: Alkippos #3682 was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
